SELECT payment.id AS id, payment.payment_id AS paymentId, payment.payment_type AS paymentType, payment.target_id AS targetId, payment.amount AS amount, payment_status.name AS paymentStatus, payment_method.name AS paymentMethod, payment.paid_at AS paidAt, payment.created_at AS createdAt,
CASE -- 테마: 결제 완료 + 미사용일 때 환불 가능 WHEN payment_status.code = 'PS02' AND payment.payment_type = 'THEME' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM theme_purchase WHERE theme_purchase.payment_id = payment.id AND theme_purchase.is_used = FALSE ) THEN TRUE
-- 구독: 결제 완료 상태라면 환불 가능 WHEN payment_status.code = 'PS02' AND payment.payment_type = 'SUBSCRIPTION' THEN TRUE
ELSE FALSE END AS refundAvailable
FROM payment
JOIN common_code AS payment_status ON payment.status_id = payment_status.id
LEFT JOIN common_code AS payment_method ON payment.pay_method_id = payment_method.id
WHERE payment.member_id = #{memberId} AND payment_status.type = 1
ORDER BY payment.created_at DESC
